change.title: Move stop_all Science wait outside AppState with owner CAS
change.summary: Adds the bounded S2 process-local Science owner slice for stop_all. The command claims an exact typed stop request and complete in-memory owner snapshot under AppState, runs the existing stop script and TERM/KILL waits without AppState, and publishes tracking/outcome changes only after generation and identity CAS. A stale result preserves replacement Science state. Gateway teardown, command text, Science stop policy, sibling caller lock timing, and S3+ mutation leases remain unchanged.

basis: the S2 regression proves that a blocked Science stop execution does not retain the AppState mutex and that generation or owner identity drift rejects stale publication while preserving replacement runtime state
the existing R0 stop-all characterization remains the authority for always stopping the tracked Gateway and returning the existing partial-error surface when Science stop fails
the source boundary binds stop_all to the process-local owner claim, exact typed request, lock-free execution, generation and identity CAS, and the split Science execution facade
cargo check and the focused S2 unit regression passed; restricted-sandbox loopback characterization remains subject to its existing isolated execution contract
the scope preserves the existing stop script, TERM/KILL/wait sequence, receipt cleanup, command text, sibling stop caller timing, and excludes S3 mutation leases and Gateway ownership changes
